text:
zoe (sales): RetailCo POC failed to pin `luma-7b-16k` in ap-northeast-1. They get `model_not_available`. Demo tomorrow AM. need quick plan.

hiro (RetailCo): payload: {"model":"luma-7b-16k","pin":true}. Response: 404 model_not_available.

maria (support): opening ticket INC-10021, grabbing traces. Preliminary: model not present in that region; only quantized variant `luma-7b-16k-quant` is there.

lee (solutions): options: 1) remove pin so we fallback to nearest region (but that's cross-region), 2) pin to quant variant in-region (warn on quality), 3) request a preload to ap-northeast (6-9h).

ada (security): note from questionnaire: RetailCo requires CMK for any POC handling customer data. Hosted POC uses platform KMS only; CMK requires Dedicated/Private onboarding.

quentin (finance): rough Dedicated POC price to include CMK + preload ops: ~$5k week, we can offer $2k credit.

zoe (sales): hiro - which do you prefer for tomorrow: quant variant for demo or postpone to allow preload with CMK?

hiro (RetailCo): demo tomorrow must be EU/APAC local. Can't accept cross-region. We'll take quant variant for demo, but we need QA notes on regressions.

maria (support): I'll run quick A/B on their sample prompts and attach to INC-10021 in ~3h.

lee (solutions): i'll prepare short appendix about known differences between float and quant and suggested prompt adjustments.

ada (security): I'll send the CMK onboarding checklist and expected timeline for Dedicated.

zoe (sales): summary action items: maria run A/B and update INC-10021; lee draft appendix; quentin prep POC quote; nada send CMK checklist. I'll reply to RetailCo with two paths.

hiro (RetailCo): thanks, please confirm by EOD JST.
